stem: At the Winter Solstice the noon altitude of the Sun at the Tropic of Cancer is :
expl: The winter solstice falls around 22 December when rays of the Sun fall perpendicular upon the Tropic of Capricorn because the Earth is tilted at its axis by 23030'. Therefore when at the Tropic of Capricorn the elevation of the Sun is 900, the elevation of the Sun at the Tropic of Cancer will be 900 – 470 = 430 at the same time. The difference between the Tropic of Cancer and Tropic of Capricorn is 23030'+23030'= 47o.

stem:
Which of the following statements is true regarding earth movement?
1. Earth rotates on its axis from west to east resulting into seasonal changes.
2. Earth revolution around sun results into occurrence of day and night on earth.
expl: Earth has seasons because its axis of rotation is tilted at an angle of 23.50. Hence statement 1 is incorrect. It is worth mentioning that night and day occur due to the Earth's rotation on its axis. Hence statement 2 is also incorrect.

stem: Which of the following phenomenon happens in India when the sun-shines vertically over the Tropic of Capricorn?

options.label: a
options.text: High pressure develops over North-West India

options.label: b
options.text: Low pressure develops over North-West India

options.label: c
options.text: No change in pressure occurs over North-West India

expl: When the sun shines vertically over the Tropic of Capricorn, the northwestern part of India becomes colder than the Arabian Sea and high pressure develops over northwest India.
